page.layout: One column of verse, full width, with the running head above it. Below the last line, at the right, the catchword. No page number and no margin notes.

l.i: Terra hiat, ambustis, heu, quum sitientia marcent
Prata comis, ægrisque macet seges arida culmis.
Nam Pater è cælo miserans incommoda nostra,
Protinus accersit nubes, dextráque capaci
Exprimit & vitam reddit morientibus herbis.
Hic magnus naturæ Opifex, cui fulmina parent,
Ventíque & nymborum præcipites cataractæ:
Hinc euersa metit tercti fata grandine creber
Africus, hinc mæstos fructus carbunculat ardens
Euronotus, miseras vites hinc frigidus imber
Sole nouo nimius sterili rubigine tentat.
Putribus hinc Zephyris urenti cuspide voluox[?]
Pampíneas frondes intorquet, & enecat uvas
Nascentes uvas & adhuc in flore latentes.
Iam mihi nunc igitur madidos venerare Lyæos,
Panáque, Robigúmq; deum, Cererémque, Iouémque
Iunonísque niues, & quicquid cæca vetustas
Mentita est: Procul hinc Vates procul ite profani:
Auditisne Deum, ô miseri, vocemque tonantis
Horrendam Vocem quæ vasto in nubis inani
Mugitus ciet horrificos, clangitque tremendum?
Hæc Vox quæ medijs olim metuenda tenebris
Increpitans, largo signauit fulgure Sinam.
Quæ piceásque ornósque & cani immania Iuræ
Fragmina præcipitat, longæuáque robora circùm
Deiciens, latéque casas campósque iacentes
Obruit, & subito fordas conquassat abortu!
Ferrea Vox hæc illa Dei, quæ sicubi fractas
Hìc illic celeri percurrit lumine nubes,
Intortámque facem Stridens agit ignea glauco
Sulphure & insanum rapido vomit impete fulmen,
Quæ tibi mens Epicure? malus timor unde repente.
Téque tuúmq; gregem, miser, occupat, urget & urit
Intus agens, subigítque Deum. scelerate, fateri:

page.notes: Small stray marks appear after "Sinam." and after "repente" at the line ends; they look like printer's marks or specks, so they are left out. "voluox" is doubtful and marked. Some letters in the italic type are faint, but the lines were read in full.
